mathematical_meanings: Left image: The curve plots a function with its minimum on the y-axis. Right image: The curve plots a function whose output is lowest at the bottom of the U.
Rationales: In both images the feature traces a function that reaches its lowest output at the bottom of the U. The red U-shaped trace with its lowest point on the y-axis. The narrow blue U-shaped graph with its vertex just left of the y-axis.
